entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1  P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, J
Dated this the 10th day of October, 2024  ORDER
This Criminal Miscellaneous case is filed to quash the FIR in Crime No.421/2018 of Pettah Police Station.
This Criminal Miscellaneous case is pending before this Court from 2018 onwards.
The offence alleged include the offence under Sec. 376 IPC also.
It is submitted that the matter is settled.
I am of the considered opinion that this Court need not consider the same, at this stage.

Probably,
the final report might have been filed because there was no interim order.
If the final report is filed and if the petitioner is aggrieved by the same, the petitioner is free to challenge the same, in accordance with law.
With the above observation, this Criminal Miscellaneous case is disposed of.

Sd/-
